facts.fact: Africa50 and Bayobab (MTN Group) announced a partnership in May 2023 to co-develop Project East2West, a US$320-325 million terrestrial fibre network linking landlocked countries to east and west coast subsea cables, with Mozambique among the twelve countries named as covered.

systems.platform: terrestrial fibre optic (dark and active fibre)
systems.owner: Bayobab (MTN Group), with Africa50 as co-developer
